title: Orphan TinyLM: retired silicon writes stories
summary: Retired silicon writes stories: real Llama language models (Karpathy's stories15M and stories42M, MIT) with every matrix product in the FPGA: 64 multiply lanes stream 8-bit weights from DDR, up to 4 stories share one pass. Three modes: Write, 4 Stories, and Adventure (4 takes of every chapter, you pick). DDR streaming from Ardzy's AI Studio (by chryso, GPL-3.0). by JMSCNC, makers of RotatoCAM.
quickstart: Load orphan_tinylm. Its page opens on port 8000 (the first start puts the models into DDR and self-checks the FPGA).
Pick a model: Stories 15M (fast) or Stories 42M (better stories).
Type a simple story opening, for example: Once upon a time, a little robot
Write = one story; 4 Stories = four versions at once; Adventure = 4 takes of each chapter, press Pick this to continue the one you like.
Race compares 1 story, 4 at once, and the ARM alone.

slots.1: tlm_gemv: int8 matrix x 4 vectors (64 lanes), weights streamed from DDR (HP0 + HP2), 16-bit results
